name: Humanly
long_description:
Our mission is to empower the world’s hiring teams to grow engaged, high-performing organizations - by delivering human connection at scale through innovative technology, commitment, and fairness.

High-volume hiring is extremely broken - it is inefficient, ineffective, and biased. Our mission is to fix what is broken. We believe great hiring processes are centered around quality conversations between candidates and employers and a future where every candidate’s journey starts with a conversation - a future where candidates are considered without bias or archaic artifacts like resumes and cover letters.
one_liner: We empower the world’s hiring teams to grow engaged, high-performing…

question_answers.question: What is the core problem you are solving? Why is this a big problem? What made you decide to work on it?
question_answers.answer: At Humanly, we're revolutionizing the hiring experience for candidates and employers by putting conversations at the heart of every hiring journey.We are building a product that empowers hiring teams to excel at every step of the recruitment process. Our AI-powered, end-to-end recruiting solution enables hiring teams to source, attract, screen, schedule, and convert candidates, at scale.Our vision is about more than tracking across recruiting efforts. It’s about enabling human connection, allowing recruiters to focus on building relationships, and keeping candidate experience and hiring teams at the core of everything we do. It is our mission to help create a better version of hiring, one that is more equitable, efficient, productive, and ultimately, more human.

question_answers.question: What is your long-term vision? If you truly succeed, what will be different about the world?
question_answers.answer: Become the global leader in ethical AI for recruiting, empowering hiring teams to eliminate the administrative work of running a high-volume, equitable hiring process.
